newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - C-Cube falls, EDS seen off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - C-Cube falls, EDS seen off.

text.p: C-Cube Microsystems Inc's warning of lower-than-expected second quarter results sent the company's shares seven points lower to 18-1/2 in heavy trade ahead of Tuesday's U.S. market open, traders said.
Earlier, C-Cube said it expects to report second quarter earnings between $0.20 and $0.25 per share on revenues of about $70 million to $75 million, both below expectations.

In the year-ago second quarter, revenues were $73 million and earnings per share were $0.39, the company said. The company reported revenues of $94 million and earnings per share of $0.41 for the first quarter ended March 31.
